name: cc-orq
description: Delegate tasks to external coding agents (Codex, OpenCode, Antigravity, Claude) from Claude Code, as MCP tasks that /tasks lists and that wake the session with the result. A stdio MCP server serves the tools capabilities, delegate, answer, status, list, cancel and integrate; the mod adds the cc-orq:task agent, the task card, /orq-panel and /orq.

cardDisplay.title: Task card
cardDisplay.description: Where orq shows its background jobs: band (above the prompt), status (the status line) or off.
